en.title: Teardown of ZWO ASIAIR astrophotography controller firmware reveals an unencrypted control protocol

Main control runs over plaintext JSON-RPC on port 4700. The original firmware is not distributed, and the author is openly looking for someone with a device to take over.

en.title: Reverse-engineering Typeless with REA and building a no-login replacement in 25 minutes
en.summary: After Typeless cut its free quota, the author asked Claude to install REA and reverse-engineer the app. Scanning 10,499 files showed that both speech recognition and AI polishing run server-side. 25 minutes later, they had a comparable replacement on their Mac that needs no login and no subscription, with a video demo.
en.metric: Working replacement built in 25 minutes; 10,499 files scanned

zh-CN.target: Typeless（macOS 语音输入 App）
zh-CN.metric: 25 分钟做出可用替代品，扫描 10,499 个文件

en.title: Taking apart Obsidian's graph view engine with REA and rebuilding its physics with identical values
en.summary: The author pointed REA at Obsidian and, in about 8 minutes 51 seconds, located the engine behind the graph view. The physics runs in a hidden Web Worker, with a WebAssembly core loop. Opus 5.5 then rebuilt the physics from scratch using the same values, and a video demo was produced.
en.metric: Graph engine found in 8 min 51 s; physics rebuilt with identical values

zh-CN.title: 用 REA 拆解 Obsidian 图谱视图引擎并以相同数值重建物理
zh-CN.summary: 作者将 REA 对准 Obsidian，约 8 分 51 秒找出图谱视图背后的引擎，发现物理运算在隐藏的 Web Worker 中，核心循环为 WebAssembly。随后由 Opus 5.5 以相同数值从头重建物理，并制作了视频演示。
zh-CN.target: Obsidian 图谱视图（Electron 应用，27 MB）
zh-CN.metric: 8 分 51 秒找出图谱引擎，并用相同数值重建物理

en.title: Studying the Jianying format with REA to rewrite ReaCut, an open-source video editor
en.summary: The goal is an independent desktop editor similar to Jianying/CapCut, built from authorized behavior and research into the local project format. It uses Electron, React, TypeScript and FFmpeg, and offers multi-track editing, subtitles, export and a Codex plugin. The v0.5.0 macOS DMG has been released. The project is still early, and only macOS arm64 has been verified.
en.target: Jianying / CapCut UI behavior and local project format
en.metric: v0.5.0 macOS DMG and Codex plugin package released, with multi-track editing and H.264 export

zh-CN.title: 借助 REA 研究剪映格式，重写开源视频编辑器 ReaCut
zh-CN.summary: 目标是以授权范围内的行为与本地工程格式研究为基础，独立实现类似剪映／CapCut 的桌面剪辑器。使用 Electron、React、TypeScript 与 FFmpeg，提供多轨剪辑、字幕、导出与 Codex 插件，并发布了 v0.5.0 的 macOS DMG。项目仍处于早期，仅验证了 macOS arm64。
zh-CN.target: 剪映 / CapCut 的界面行为与本地工程格式
zh-CN.metric: 发布 v0.5.0 的 macOS DMG 与 Codex 插件包，含多轨剪辑与 H.264 导出

en.title: Reverse-engineering the iOS remote feature to build web remotes for Apple TV and LG TVs
en.summary: Using REA with Ghidra to analyze the built-in iOS remote, the author recovered the Apple TV Companion protocol and verified it on a real device. Based on this, they built a web remote that controls Apple TV, LG webOS TVs and Spotify. They use it daily in their own setup, and the project is still in progress.
en.metric: Tested working on a 3rd-generation Apple TV 4K, with touchpad, app launch and text input support

zh-CN.metric: 在 Apple TV 4K 第三代上实测可用，支持触控板、App 启动与文字输入

en.title: Testing REA against encryption, packing, and conventional VMP protection
en.summary: Starting from a simple program, the author layered on encryption, packing, VMP protection, and software cloning, stress-testing REA over two days. Conventional packing and conventional VMP were both cracked; only the final virtualization stage held. The author credits the capability mainly to the large model and IDA rather than REA itself.
en.target: Test programs with encryption, packing, and VMP protection
en.metric: Conventional VMP packing cracked; only the final virtualization stage remained unbroken

zh-CN.title: 实测 REA 破解加密、加壳与常规 VMP 保护

zh-CN.target: 带有加密、加壳、VMP 保护的测试程序
zh-CN.metric: 常规 VMP 加壳被破,仅虚拟化最后关卡未攻破

en.title: Tracing the Export button flow in a Notes sample app with REA and building a small feature of my own
en.summary: The author ran REA on a six-file Notes sample app and mapped 29 app nodes and 42 relationships, each backed by source-code evidence. They then traced the Export button: the page calls an export method, the bridge sends a notes:export message, and the main handler formats the data and writes notes.csv. The author used this to implement a small feature of their own.
en.metric: 29 app nodes, 42 relationships; recovered the notes:export → notes.csv flow

en.summary: Used REA and Ghidra for static analysis of FalloutNV.exe to find out how the game saves and restores object positions when the player leaves and re-enters a cell, or saves and loads. Produced a spec in which every rule is marked as observation, inference, or design choice and cites an REA evidence ID, then wrote a JavaScript implementation and tests from scratch based on that spec.
en.metric: Reimplemented from the spec, with 31 tests

zh-CN.title: 逆向《辐射：新维加斯》物件位置跨区域保存机制并重新实现

en.title: Analyzing the Chrome dinosaur game with REA and rebuilding a playable version with regression tests
en.summary: Used REA to passively inspect the JavaScript loaded by Chrome's T-Rex Runner over CDP, tracing speed assignment, collision, and animation scheduling. Codex then independently rewrote an HTML5 Canvas version from the findings, adding inline unit and integration tests with fault mutations, plus a playable online demo. Key finding: movement depends on elapsed time, but speed increments only once per qualifying update.
en.metric: Playable online demo, with inline tests and a Node test harness

zh-CN.title: 用 REA 分析 Chrome 恐龙游戏并重建可玩版本与回归测试
zh-CN.summary: 以 REA 通过 CDP 被动检视 Chrome T-Rex Runner 载入的 JavaScript，追踪速度赋值、碰撞与动画调度。Codex 据此独立重写 HTML5 Canvas 版本，加入内嵌单元与集成测试及故障变异，并提供在线可玩演示。关键发现是移动依经过时间，但速度每次合格更新才递增一次。
zh-CN.target: Chrome T-Rex Runner（浏览器游戏）
zh-CN.metric: 可玩的在线演示，附内嵌测试与 Node 测试框架

en.title: Studying WinDirStat with REA and building a disk analyzer in Rust and Tauri
en.summary: Used REA with Ghidra to analyze the installed WinDirStat 2.5.0, confirming behaviors such as directory listing via NtQueryDirectoryFile, a separate MFT reader, and SHA-512 hashing for duplicate detection. Most algorithms were ported from its open-source code, so REA mainly served to verify them against the running program. AI built the Rust engine and Svelte UI; the author admits not reviewing the code, and some features remain untested.
en.metric: 24 automated engine tests; real-world scan of a C: drive with about 1.3 million files

zh-CN.title: 用 REA 研究 WinDirStat 并以 Rust 与 Tauri 做出磁盘分析器

zh-CN.target: WinDirStat 2.5.0（Windows 磁盘分析器）
zh-CN.metric: 24 个引擎自动测试，实测扫描约 130 万个文件的 C: 磁盘

zh-CN.target: 各种 agent harness(Claude、Cursor、Codex、openclaw 等)
zh-CN.metric: 支持 5 种 harness,一条命令完成安装

en.title: A one-command tool built on REA for analyzing desktop app architecture
en.summary: The goal is to reconstruct a desktop app's architecture from its shipped binary, without access to source code. The project, Murti, is a local voice dictation tool for macOS, and its Inspect feature is powered by REA. The excerpt mainly covers the dictation feature and does not describe any concrete results from Inspect.
en.metric: No concrete Inspect results shown in the excerpt

zh-CN.title: 用 REA 做出一行命令分析桌面应用架构的工具
zh-CN.summary: 目标是不靠源代码,从已发布的二进制文件还原桌面应用架构。项目 Murti 是 macOS 本地语音听写工具,其中的 Inspect 功能由 REA 驱动。节选主要介绍听写功能,Inspect 的具体成果没有说明。
zh-CN.target: 桌面应用程序的架构分析(Murti Inspect)
zh-CN.metric: 节选中未见 Inspect 的具体成果
